keywords = [
    KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.FLYING),
]
abilities = [

    TriggeredAbility(
        event=ZoneChangeEvent(
            from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
            to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        ),
        condition=FAtom(
            pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
            count=QConst(value=1),
            quantity=QCount(
                selector=Selector(
                    count=QUnbounded(),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.NAME_EQ, string_value='Faerie Miscreant'),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                            FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
    ),
    # [1]
    SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE),

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, if you control another creature named Faerie Miscreant, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: Tree reads right: ZoneChangeEvent(IS_SOURCE, to battlefield YOU) with the intervening-if as the condition: QTY_GE 1 over a count of battlefield objects FAnd(CONTROLLER_IS YOU, NAME_EQ 'Faerie Miscreant', TYPE_EQ Creature, FNot(IS_SOURCE)); effect DRAW 1 controller YOU. The trace only shows the negative side ([cast]: hand 7 -> 6, no other Miscreant, no draw, so the entering creature is not its own 'another'); no stimulus puts a second Miscreant in play. F00_1 draws exactly one card with another of your own Miscreants in play; F00_2 draws nothing with only a differently named creature of yours plus the opponent's Miscreant; F00_3/F00_4 hold the trigger on the stack and show the condition is checked again as it resolves (CR 603.4).
